title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement
tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

judge.summary: A polished square post pairs a clearly readable green headline with abundant lush potted houseplants against a clean cream background.

must_haves.item: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
must_haves.why: The headline matches exactly, arranged across two lines.

must_haves.item: Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
must_haves.why: Numerous leafy houseplants in varied pots fill the lower portion against a cream wall.

must_haves.item: The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.
must_haves.why: The large dark-green lettering contrasts clearly with the background and is fully within the image.
Only the requested headline is visible.
